test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

He certainly failed to __console____ __the new king.
solution:
The correct answer is Agitate.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate antonym of the given word 'console' is 'Agitate'.
 
• Console: to make somebody happier when he/she is very sad or disappointed
 
• Meaning of the given options:
 
 
• *Agitate: to make other people feel very strongly about something so that they want to help you achieve it*
 
• Coordinate: to organize different things or people so that they work together
 
• Satiate: to completely satisfy a desire or need
 
• Gratify: to give somebody pleasure and satisfaction
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 1.​
